formatNotes: First year of the 'super regional' qualification format: the Open fed 8 combined regionals, each sending its top 5 men and top 5 women, for fields of 40 per division. No athletes were cut during the Games. Most events were worth 100 points to the winner on a graduated table (2nd = 94, 7th = 72, etc.); Sprint Courses 1 and 2 were worth 50 points each. Individual competition opened Wednesday, July 22 with an offsite ocean event at Hermosa Beach Pier; Thursday, July 23 was a rest day; competition resumed Friday through Sunday at the StubHub Center.
yearSummary: The 2015 Games were defined by brutal, heavy programming and new implements. Individual competition opened in the ocean at Hermosa Beach Pier, then moved through a stadium sandbag carry, the hero workout Murph in 20/14-lb body armor in mid-day heat (causing multiple heat casualties, including Annie Thorisdottir's heat stroke and Kara Webb's collapse), a community-voted Heavy DT, and a 1RM clean and jerk. Sunday's Pedal to the Metal finale debuted the pegboard and the Assault bike; the pegboard stopped nearly the entire women's field. Ben Smith, a perennial podium contender since 2009, finally won the men's title, while 22-year-old Katrin Davidsdottir won the final event to overtake Sara Sigmundsdottir and claim the women's crown over runner-up Tia-Clair Toomey.

events.name: Pier Paddle
events.description:
For time:
Swim 500 meters
Paddle 2 miles
Swim 500 meters

Athletes begin on the beach and swim 500 meters around the Hermosa Beach Pier, then return to the beach to grab paddleboards. They paddle south for 1 mile, turn around, and paddle 1 mile back, return the boards to the beach, then swim around the pier again, climb out of the water and cross the finish line.
events.notes: Offsite opener at Hermosa Beach Pier on Wednesday morning. Kara Webb (now Kara Saunders) won the women's event; the official leaderboard lists her under her married name.

events.name: Sandbag 2015
events.description:
For time:
Move 720 lb (men) / 480 lb (women) of sandbags across the stadium
Men: four 100-lb bags and four 80-lb bags
Women: four 70-lb bags and four 50-lb bags

Athletes begin on the stadium floor and run to the top of the stairs on the north side of the tennis stadium, then must move all eight sandbags down the stairs, across the stadium floor, up the wall, and to the top of the stairs on the south side. Each athlete has access to a wheelbarrow for moving bags across the floor. The event is complete when all bags have been piled on the opposite side of the stadium.
events.notes: Wednesday evening in the tennis stadium. Women's winner Anna Tunnicliffe (Olympic sailing gold medalist) appears on the official leaderboard under her married name, Anna Tobias.

events.name: Murph
events.description:
For time, wearing 20-lb (men) / 14-lb (women) body armor:
1-mile run
100 pull-ups
200 push-ups
300 squats
1-mile run

No partitioning. Starting in the stadium, athletes run out through the tunnel, up the loading dock ramp, onto the road and down to the turnaround, then back along the same route. They then complete all 100 pull-ups (advancing to the next bar every 25 reps), all 200 push-ups (advancing every 50 reps), and all 300 squats (advancing every 75 reps), then finish with another 1-mile run on the same route, with time stopping at the finish line in the stadium.
events.notes: First time the hero WOD Murph was contested at the Games, run unpartitioned in mid-afternoon July heat. Multiple athletes suffered heat illness: Kara Webb collapsed at the finish line and Annie Thorisdottir suffered heat stroke, failed to finish, and withdrew from the competition. The fallout shaped how Murph was programmed in 2016 (partitioning allowed, earlier heats).

events.name: Snatch Speed Ladder
events.description:
Bracket event in 3 rounds; athletes are ranked by time to complete each ladder or by the heaviest weight snatched. All snatches are squat snatches, one rep per bar across 5 bars of increasing weight.

Quarterfinal round, for time:
1 squat snatch 190 / 110 lb
1 squat snatch 200 / 115 lb
1 squat snatch 205 / 120 lb
1 squat snatch 210 / 125 lb
1 squat snatch 215 / 130 lb
Top 20 athletes advance.

Semifinal round, for time:
1 squat snatch 220 / 135 lb
1 squat snatch 230 / 140 lb
1 squat snatch 235 / 145 lb
1 squat snatch 240 / 150 lb
1 squat snatch 245 / 155 lb
Top 10 athletes advance.

Final round, for time:
1 squat snatch 250 / 160 lb
1 squat snatch 260 / 165 lb
1 squat snatch 265 / 170 lb
1 squat snatch 270 / 175 lb
1 squat snatch 275 / 180 lb
events.notes: Modeled on the 2014 Clean Speed Ladder. Scored by bracket placement; the official leaderboard archive records placement points rather than times/loads, publishing the winners' scores as '1 pt' (recorded here as the winning score) with no winning time or load. The squat-snatch (full-depth) requirement caused some controversy in the women's bracket. Games rookie Brooke Ence missed her first attempt at the final bar then made it to win. One retrospective (The Barbell Spin) lists the women's top bar as 185 lb, but the official workout page says 180 lb.

events.name: Heavy DT
events.description:
5 rounds for time of:
12 deadlifts
9 hang power cleans
6 push jerks

Men: 205 lb. Women: 145 lb.
Athletes complete 5 rounds of the barbell complex, advancing forward to the next barbell after each round.
events.notes: Heavier version of the hero WOD DT (normally 155/105 lb). The community chose this event by Twitter vote, #DoubleDT vs #HeavyDT; Heavy DT won.

events.name: Sprint Course 1
events.description:
For time:
Sprint north across the soccer stadium field through an obstacle course, weaving through four pylons and clearing four hurdles.

Athletes receive a 2-second penalty for each knocked-over hurdle. Scored as a separate 50-point event from Sprint Course 2.
events.notes: Worth 50 points instead of the standard 100. After one minute of rest, athletes reset and ran the course back the other way as Sprint Course 2. The obstacle counts (four pylons in a zig-zag, four hurdles, with Course 1 starting on the pylons) and the one-minute rest are per Wikipedia's event description; the official workout page describes only a sprint 'through a series of obstacles' with a 2-second penalty per knocked hurdle.

events.name: Sprint Course 2
events.description:
For time:
After one minute of rest following Sprint Course 1, sprint south back through the same obstacle course in the opposite direction, negotiating the same four pylons and four hurdles.

Athletes receive a 2-second penalty for each knocked-over hurdle. Scored as a separate 50-point event from Sprint Course 1.
events.notes: Worth 50 points instead of the standard 100. Dan Bailey swept both sprint events on the men's side. The obstacle counts (four pylons, four hurdles), the opposite-direction layout, and the one-minute rest after Sprint Course 1 are per Wikipedia's event description; the official workout page describes only a sprint 'through a series of obstacles' with a 2-second penalty per knocked hurdle.

events.name: Soccer Chipper
events.description:
For time:
100-ft Pig flip (560 / 395 lb)
4 legless rope climbs
100-ft handstand walk

Athletes flip the Pig halfway across the field to the rig, perform 4 legless rope climbs, then handstand walk 100 ft divided into 50-ft sections. Each section must be completed unbroken; if the athlete comes down from their hands they must return to the start of that section.
events.notes: Featured the Rogue Pig 2.0, heavier than the original Pig that debuted at the 2013 Games Burden Run (490/310 lb).

events.name: Clean and Jerk
events.description:
1-rep-max clean and jerk

Each athlete has two 20-second windows in which to attempt their heaviest clean and jerk for one repetition. Score is the heaviest successful lift.
events.notes: Brooke Ence's 242 lb capped a double on the night for the rookie after her Snatch Speed Ladder win the previous evening. The two-attempt format ('two 20-second windows... for one repetition') is per Wikipedia's event description; the official workout page lists only '1-rep-max clean and jerk'. Winning loads confirmed by the official leaderboard archive.

events.name: Triangle Couplet
events.description:
15-10-6 reps for time of:
Thrusters (165 / 115 lb)
Bar muscle-ups

Athletes complete 15 thrusters and 15 bar muscle-ups, then 10 thrusters and 10 bar muscle-ups, then 6 thrusters and 6 bar muscle-ups. After each round the athlete advances the barbell forward to the next rep mat. The event is complete when the athlete finishes the last bar muscle-up and crosses the finish line.

events.name: Midline Madness
events.description:
6 rounds for time of:
400-meter run
50-ft yoke carry (380 / 300 lb)

Athletes begin on the field and complete 6 rounds of a running lap up and over the stadium berm followed by a 50-ft yoke carry. The event is complete when the athlete carries the yoke across the finish line of the last section.
events.notes: Official site listed the event name with a typo as 'MIdline Madness'. Sam Briggs's win was her second event victory of the weekend.

events.name: Pedal to the Metal 1
events.description:
For time:
3 pegboard ascents
24-calorie row
16-calorie bike (Assault bike)
8 dumbbell squat snatches (100 / 70 lb)

Athletes move through the stations in order. The event is complete when the athlete finishes the last rep of the dumbbell squat snatch and crosses the finish line. Athletes then have a brief rest before resetting and beginning Pedal to the Metal 2.
events.notes: Games debut of both the pegboard and the Assault bike. The pegboard stalled almost the entire women's field: only three women completed the three ascents and no woman finished the event inside the cap; Margaux Alvarez won at CAP+8.

events.name: Pedal to the Metal 2
events.description:
For time:
12 parallette handstand push-ups
24-calorie row
16-calorie bike (Assault bike)
8 kettlebell deadlifts (203 / 124 lb)

Begins just after completing Pedal to the Metal 1. Athletes move through the stations in order; the event is complete when the athlete finishes the last rep of the kettlebell deadlift and crosses the finish line.
events.notes: Final event of the Games, using oversized 203-lb / 124-lb kettlebells. Katrin Davidsdottir won the event to seal the women's title; Ben Smith finished 4th in the event, enough to clinch the men's championship. Spencer Hendel swept both Pedal to the Metal events.
